vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate is the only updater here, so it also handles security remediation. This reads GitHub's Dependabot *alerts*, which are a separate feature from Dependabot version updates and must stay enabled under Settings > Code security.

packageRules.description: Merge patch and minor bumps once CI is green. Majors are left for a human - the antd v6 bump is exactly the kind of change that needs eyes on it.
